segments.name: Beauty & Wellbeing
products: skin care (face, hand and body moisturisers)
segments.description: Sells hair care, skin care, prestige beauty and wellbeing products to consumers.
segments.evidence: Beauty & Wellbeing ■ primarily sales of hair care (shampoo, conditioner, styling), skin care (face, hand and body moisturisers), and includes Prestige Beauty and Wellbeing.

segments.name: Personal Care
segments.description: Sells skin cleansing, deodorant and oral care products to consumers.
segments.evidence: Personal Care ■ primarily sales of skin cleansing (soap, shower), deodorant and oral care (toothpaste, toothbrush, mouthwash) products.

segments.name: Home Care
products: fabric care (washing powders and liquids, rinse conditioners)
segments.description: Sells fabric care and home and hygiene cleaning products to consumers.
segments.evidence: Home Care ■ primarily sales of fabric care (washing powders and liquids, rinse conditioners) and a wide range of home and hygiene cleaning products.

segments.name: Foods
segments.description: Sells cooking aids, mini-meals, condiments and food solutions to consumers and food service customers.
segments.evidence: Foods (previously Nutrition) ■ primarily sales of cooking aids & mini-meals (soups, bouillons, seasonings), condiments (mayonnaise, ketchup) and Unilever Food Solutions.

revenueModel.text: Unilever earns turnover from sales of goods to customers, recognised when control of products transfers, generally on delivery.
revenueModel.evidence: Turnover comprises sales of goods after the deduction of discounts, sales taxes and estimated returns.

changes.text: In 2025 the Ice Cream business was demerged and is presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: The Ice Cream business met the criteria to be classified as held for distribution in December 2025, following the Board's formal approval of the demerger.

changes.text: In 2025 the Foods segment was renamed from Nutrition.
changes.evidence: Following the demerger of the Ice Cream business, the Group's operating and reportable segments are the four Business Groups of Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care, Home Care and Foods (previously reported as Nutrition).

changes.text: In 2025 the categories Cooking Aids and Condiments were renamed from Scratch Cooking Aids and Dressings respectively.
changes.evidence: * Cooking Aids previously reported as Scratch Cooking Aids; Condiments previously reported as Dressings.
